title: Minimum Number of Refueling Stops
description: Calculate minimum refueling stops to reach target using a max-priority queue to greedily pick the largest available fuel source.
pseudocode:
1. Initialize current_fuel = startFuel, stops = 0, pq = max_heap
2. For each station in stations:
3.   While current_fuel < station_position: pop from pq, add to current_fuel, stops++
4.   Push station_fuel to pq
5. While current_fuel < target: pop from pq, add to current_fuel, stops++
6. Return stops

steps.note: Initialize starting fuel and stops count.
Check if current fuel (1) is sufficient to reach target (1). Since 1 >= 1, no stops needed.
